texts.zh: 自己在宇宙中并不孤单，这一发现让[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]上的许多人感到震惊。毫不奇怪，这一事件产生了严重的经济影响。随着整颗星球上的金融机构暴跌不止，生活水平明显下降。
texts.en: The revelation that they were not alone in the universe came as a shock to many on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]. Not surprisingly, the event has had severe economic effects. With financial institutions across the planet in free-fall, there has been a marked decrease in the planet's standard of living.

texts.zh:
我们为[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]提供的金融刺激措施已经得到了丰厚的回报。他们的传统货币和经济机构在我们的支持下，终于稳定了下来。

也许更重要的是，公众对我们继续留在该星系中的支持度空前高涨。
texts.en:
The financial stimulus we provided to [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName] has paid off handsomely. With their traditional currencies and economic institutions bolstered by our support, conditions have finally stabilized.

Perhaps more importantly, public approval for our continued presence in the system has never been higher.

texts.zh:
我们对市场仁慈的信任得到了丰厚的回报。

摆脱了令人窒息的监管，[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]的金融机构已经稳定下来。那里的人们知道自己的经济前景一片大好，可以放心了。
texts.en:
Our trust in the benevolence of the market has paid off handsomely.

Freed from the imposition of stifling regulations, financial institutions on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName] have stabilized. The people there can rest secure in the knowledge that their economic future is assured.

texts.zh: 我们对[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]市场自我纠正的信任变成了一场灾难，实在令人费解。事实上，星球上的状况前所未有的糟糕，人们吵着要政府加强对金融部门的监督。
texts.en: Inexplicably, our trust in the market to right itself on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName] has been a disaster. In fact, conditions on the planet have never been worse, and the people there are clamoring for increased government oversight in the financial sector.
